correctness.rationale: Each of the twelve vertices has one triangle membership and one bridge membership. Assigning the field to bridge terms below K, or K per spin to bridges and the remainder to triangle terms above K, produces simultaneously sharp lower bounds for arbitrary real positive J,K and h>=0. Equality classes are proved feasible and counted by exact tournaments and forbidden-reciprocal assignments on K4. At all boundaries the exact magnetization sectors follow. Independent exact enumeration of 4096 configurations across seven distinct coupling ratios and multiple fields confirms all stated formulas; the analytical argument, not sampled fields, supplies the general proof.

value.rationale: A physically motivated 12-site molecule-like frustrated graph has two independent bond orbits. The result solves the full nonperturbative field phase diagram uniformly over both positive exchanges, demonstrates a robust one-third plateau and two genuine magnetization jumps, and proves exact 114- and 163-state coexistence manifolds with their zero-temperature entropy counts. These are natural complete finite thermodynamic invariants and structural constraints, not a parameter-specific numerical fit or rebranding of generic plateau existence.
